title: Possessive Pronouns
grammarPoint: mój, moja, moje / twój, twoja, twoje — agreement with noun gender
grammarPoint_fa: ضمایر ملکی: mój/moja/moje، twój/twoja/twoje و غیره

explanation.text:
Polish possessive pronouns agree with the **gender of the noun they modify**, not the gender of the owner. The most important ones for beginners are the 1st and 2nd person singular forms:

| Possessive | Masculine | Feminine | Neuter |
|------------|-----------|----------|--------|
| my (1st sg.) | **mój** | **moja** | **moje** |
| your (2nd sg.) | **twój** | **twoja** | **twoje** |
| his | **jego** | **jego** | **jego** |
| her | **jej** | **jej** | **jej** |
| our | **nasz** | **nasza** | **nasze** |
| your (pl.) | **wasz** | **wasza** | **wasze** |

Remember: choose the form to match the noun, not the speaker.
notes: mój/twój have a special plural: moi/twoi (virile), moje/twoje (non-virile).
jego/jej do not change — they are indeclinable.
In practice, Poles often drop the possessive when context is clear: 'Gdzie jest mama?' not 'Gdzie jest moja mama?'

explanation_fa: ضمایر ملکی با جنسیت اسم تطبیق می‌یابند: mój (مذکر)، moja (مؤنث)، moje (خنثی/جمع). همینطور: twój/twoja/twoje (مال تو)، jego/jej (مال او)، nasz/nasza/nasze (مال ما)، wasz/wasza/wasze (مال شما)، ich (مال آن‌ها).

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct possessive: To jest ___ brat. (This is my brother.)
exercises.explanation: 'Brat' (brother) is masculine, so the possessive is 'mój'. 'To jest mój brat' = This is my brother.

exercises.prompt: To jest ___ siostra. (This is your sister.) [siostra = feminine]

exercises.explanation: You heard: 'To jest nasz syn.' — This is our son. 'Syn' is masculine → 'nasz' (not nasza/nasze).

exercises.prompt: Build: This is my dog. [pies = masculine]
exercises.explanation: 'To jest mój pies' = This is my dog. 'Pies' is masculine → use 'mój'.

exercises.prompt: To jest ___ auto. (This is her car.) [auto = neuter]
exercises.explanation: 'Jej' = her (possessive, 3rd feminine). Since 'jej' is indeclinable, it stays the same regardless of the noun's gender: 'To jest jej auto'.
